text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #fff at 90% opacity. This balances visibility and subtlety—strong enough for keyboard users to track focus without overwhelming the interface. The trade-off is slightly less crisp edges on high-DPI screens, but it avoids the blurrier look of the 3px ring with 1px inner at 80% opacity.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks fading into light backgrounds where #005fcc’s contrast drops below 4.5:1. A 3px ring at 3:1 contrast (e.g., #004494) keeps focus visible on all backgrounds without bulk. Settle it with a live contrast test on 10 light backgrounds.
